scope: Screening of licensed country-level snapshots within a fixed contemporary Belarus comparison window. This is not vertex-level certification, a complete restoration of MAPA, or a digitization of internal GDL/BSSR boundaries.
controlLocations: Nineteen present-day location coordinates, stored in audit-snapshots.mjs. Modern names and locations are orientation references, not claims that every settlement existed at every date.

additions.politicalContext: Belarusian locations shown lie in the Grand Duchy, not in the Polish Crown. Casimir IV died in 1492; thereafter different Jagiellonian brothers ruled Poland and Lithuania. Do not call the whole year a single personal union or a Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. The source does not separate the Crown and the Grand Duchy geometrically.
additions.screening: All 19 control locations intersect the source grouping. The small Teutonic Knights intersection with the modern reference is not independently resolved and must remain neutral rather than becoming an asserted enclave.

additions.politicalContext: The Union of Lublin in 1569 established the Commonwealth, while the Grand Duchy retained a distinct constituent political identity. The source polygon combines the Crown and the Grand Duchy; the local GDL label is historical context, not an independently digitized internal border.
additions.screening: All 19 control locations intersect the Commonwealth grouping. The source spelling Poland-Llituania is preserved for reproducibility but should be normalized in display labels. Small source Muscovy fragments at the modern eastern reference edge remain unresolved, not certified political enclaves.
